title: Stable installation was automatically updated to a nightly build

triage_metadata.reasoning: No source files were pruned; all PR modifications directly address the reported issue.

summary.problem: Gemini CLI installations on the stable channel were automatically updated or prompted to update to nightly builds when the npm `latest` tag pointed to a nightly version.
summary.root_cause: The update detection logic lacked stability channel checking and only relied on semver comparison (`semver.gt(latestUpdate, currentVersion)`), allowing unstable nightly versions to override stable installations.
summary.context: The CLI needed channel analysis (`getChannelFromVersion`) and a stability ranking hierarchy (`STABLE > PREVIEW > NIGHTLY`) to ensure update checks and auto-update executions never downgrade a user to a less stable release channel.

steps: In `packages/core/src/utils/channel.ts`, export `RELEASE_CHANNEL_STABILITY` mapping `ReleaseChannel.NIGHTLY` to 0, `PREVIEW` to 1, and `STABLE` to 2. Export `getChannelFromVersion(version: string)` to determine the release channel based on version strings containing 'nightly' or 'preview'. Refactor `getReleaseChannel` to utilize `getChannelFromVersion`.

In `packages/cli/src/ui/utils/updateCheck.ts`, import `getChannelFromVersion` and `RELEASE_CHANNEL_STABILITY`. In `checkForUpdates`, resolve `currentChannel` and `targetChannel`. Return `null` if `RELEASE_CHANNEL_STABILITY[targetChannel] < RELEASE_CHANNEL_STABILITY[currentChannel]`.

In `packages/cli/src/utils/handleAutoUpdate.ts`, import `getChannelFromVersion` and `RELEASE_CHANNEL_STABILITY`. Add a defense-in-depth check comparing `currentChannel` and `targetChannel` stability ranks and return early without executing the install command if the target channel is less stable than the current channel.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Users on the stable channel will not receive update prompts or auto-updates for nightly or preview versions even if those versions are tagged as latest and have a higher semver.
verification_steps: Run unit tests using Vitest: `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/utils/updateCheck.test.ts packages/cli/src/utils/handleAutoUpdate.test.ts`.
Verify `checkForUpdates` returns `null` when current version is stable (e.g. `1.0.0`) and target is nightly (e.g. `1.1.0-nightly.1`) or preview (e.g. `1.1.0-preview.1`).
Verify `handleAutoUpdate` aborts execution when target update channel has a lower stability ranking than the current version.
